title: Connect production simulated relay runners
description: Reuse shared lora_medium server and real Python SimRadio/Node, Rust HAL SimRadio/RplStack owner loop, C native_sim LoRa API. Existing Python/Rust tests show mandatory-relay paths but no real mixed runner. C loopback does not connect independent nodes; TCP adapter uses Zephyr sockets requiring verified host-network connectivity; C production L2 path does not call standalone router dispatcher. Audit also finds Rust send_coap_raw_to ignores selected L2 destination. Do not use fake signatures or counter-only hetero fleet script. Recipient-as-root topology is proposed to match current Rust route shape.
acceptance_criteria: Actual stack processes exchange signed and SCHC-framed traffic over explicit A-B-C reachability, with no A-C path; chosen route next-hop is used; C relay path demonstrated; runtime ownership remains single and bounded.
notes: Infrastructure checkpoint preserved; remaining mixed runner/C relay work pending. User approved endpoint-binding design; active work switches to oa51.2. Current results/details retained in prior events.
